reply_text:
I've saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in your DM. The draft's subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It isn't sent, so someone still needs to review it and send it.

- **What it says:** the proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,101 a seat, Anselm approved sharing it, and Hollis shouldn't pass it on without his or June's okay.
- **Why no further approval was needed:** Anselm is the CFO and can approve sharing finance figures himself. Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so the rule about outside mail doesn't apply.
- **Where the figure came from:** the $2,101 is the number Anselm stated in this DM. I didn't check it against what Marcus originally sent, because that wasn't in anything Anselm can see. A search of the knowledge brain also turned up nothing on Thornbury.
